reviews.text: Steak was great!
Danielle was an excellent waitress! She was very kind, attentive, and knowledgeable about the restaurant. We felt extremely welcomed and valued, thank you for such a wonderful experience!
Danielle was really nice! She was extremely welcoming, and she accommodated really nicely for our party of 8! As someone new to Canada, it was incredibly nice to get this kind of service.
DANIELLE!!! She was amazing

DANIELLE was amazing, incredible, beautiful, awesome, so quick, so responsive, so bright and full of energy! DANIELLE was kind, patient, nice, marvelous, wonderful, animated, and maybe the most amazing server I've ever had! DANIELLE was so careful to make sure the birthday girl had an amazing time, asked for allergies, and did ALL the things she was trained to do AND MORE. DANIELLEEEEE WAS A GREAT WAITRESS TONIGHT.

The food here is amazing. I ordered something simple: the breakfast sandwich. I didn't expect much because it's just an egg and bacon sandwich. But, as is known in the culinary industry, the simplest dishes are the greatest test of skill. The egg was cooked to perfection. The bacon was crispy but not overcooked. The sauce was flavourful. Even the side salad struck the perfect balance between sharp cheese and aromatic peppercorns. The food was a delightful pairing with my $5 house lager, which was light and very drinkable.

Our server, Ewin, always made sure we had everything we needed. He even remembered everyone's name in a table of 6! He checked in regularly so I could refill my alcohol at a good pace. His friendly and personable service brightened up the experience.

Finally, the music played here is just one banger after another.  I normally don't like loud music but I loved every song that played here. It makes for an exciting but subtle background to the lively conversation you're surely having with your friends.

I will definitely be coming back. Update: i came back and had Aisia as my server. She was very pleasant and helpful!

Visited Local Public Eatery on a Sunday, while my son was at a birthday party at Skyzone, and had a great experience with my server/waiter Matthew, who was calm, friendly and able to recommend some great selections for food and drinks. Matthew was professional and made the whole outing a lovely moment for me. Thanks, LPE, for the stellar hire!
